umgebindehaus.description: Umgebinde house: log-built ground floor inside a frame of timber posts, a half-timbered upper floor, a steep roof; front (long side) facing +x

fachwerkhaus.description: Half-timbered house: two storeys of plaster and dark timber framing, a red tiled roof; front facing +x

dorfhaus.description: Plastered village house, one and a half storeys under a steep roof with a dormer; front facing +x

stadthaus.description: Town house: three storeys, gable to the street, in a row along it; shop window in the ground floor; front facing +x

stadthaus-laden.description: Town house with a shop or café on the ground floor, flats above; gable to the street; front facing +x

villa.description: Resort villa in the Bäderarchitektur style: three storeys, carved wooden verandas and a decorated gable, a hipped slate roof; front facing +x

hotel.description: Hotel in a big resort villa: four storeys, a corner tower with a pointed roof, verandas; front facing +x

gasthof.description: Country inn (Gasthof): a long half-timbered building with a hall, a sign over the door, a beer garden table; front facing +x

baude.description: Mountain inn (Baude) on a summit or viewpoint: a timbered house with a terrace and a little turret; front facing +x

scheune.description: Big barn of a Saxon four-sided farm (Vierseithof): timber boarding over a stone base, a wide gate; front facing +x

dorfkirche.description: Saxon village church: white nave with a steep roof, a west tower crowned by a slate bell-cap and lantern; the tower end faces +x

stadtkirche.description: Late-Gothic town church (like St. Marien in Pirna): a tall hall nave under a vast steep roof, buttresses, a massive west tower with a baroque cap

rathaus.description: Renaissance town hall on the market square: three storeys, stepped gables, an arcade, a little clock tower on the ridge; front facing +x

kurhaus.description: Spa house in the Kurpark: a long colonnaded hall with a central domed pavilion; front facing +x

festung-bau.description: Fortress building: a long sandstone barracks or arsenal with a hipped roof (Königstein fortress)

festung-turm.description: Fortress round tower or bastion pavilion with a slate cap (Friedrichsburg)

burg.description: Hilltop castle on a rock spur (like Burg Hohnstein): a curtain wall, a keep with a slate helm, a palace wing and a gate tower; gate facing +x

felsturm.description: Sandstone rock tower (a climbing summit): stacked, weathered blocks rising from the forest, its foot buried deep enough to stand on a cliff

felsriff.description: Sandstone rock wall: a long weathered ridge of blocks, 30 m long along y, its foot buried deep enough to stand on a cliff

basteibruecke.description: The Bastei bridge: a sandstone arch bridge of seven spans striding between rock towers, 76 m long along y

obelisk.description: Sandstone obelisk on a summit, a memorial with a gilded tip

aussichtsturm.description: Lookout tower: a sandstone tower with a timber viewing platform and a pointed roof

schutzhuette.description: Hikers' shelter: an open log hut with a bench, by the path

wegweiser.description: Hiking signpost with arms pointing the ways, and the Malerweg's sign

foerdergeruest.description: Colliery headframe: a steel lattice tower with two great sheave wheels, braced by a sloping strut; the strut leans toward −x

maschinenhaus.description: Winding-engine house of a colliery: red brick, tall arched windows, a gabled slate roof; front facing +x

schornstein.description: Tall brick factory chimney, smoking, with a stepped base

kaue.description: Colliery pithead baths and offices: a long two-storey brick building with a flat roof; front facing +x

kiefer.description: Scots pine, about 13 m: a bare reddish trunk and a flat, ragged crown (on the sandstone rocks)

birke.description: Birch, about 11 m: a white trunk and a light, airy crown

halde.description: Colliery spoil tip: a tall cone of dark grey waste rock, 40 m across

staumauer.description: Dam of the Gottleuba reservoir: a 100 m masonry gravity wall along y, battered on both faces, its crest walk 5 m above the base point; downstream is +x, the valve tower stands in the water on the -x side

baumstumpf.description: Tree stump left by the woodcutters

kohlehaufen.description: Heap of coal on the colliery's stockyard

saegehalle.description: Sawmill hall: a long open-sided timber shed over the saw line, with a log ramp; long side facing +x

stammholz.description: Pile of logs (Polter) waiting at the sawmill or a forest road, 9 m logs lying along y

bretterstapel.description: Stacks of sawn planks drying under little roofs

harvester.description: Forestry machine (harvester): a yellow six-wheeled tractor with a crane and felling head

forsthaus.description: Forester's lodge: a timbered house with antlers over the door; front facing +x

steinbruch-kran.description: Quarry derrick crane: a timber mast with a long jib over the sandstone quarry

kuhstall.description: Cowshed: a long, low byre with a ventilated ridge and big doors at the gable ends; long side facing +x

hochsilo.description: Tower silo for fodder, with a domed cap

heuballen.description: Round hay bale wrapped in white, lying in the field

rebzeile.description: Six metres of trained vines on wires between posts, the row running along x

weinberghaus.description: Vineyard house: a small white garden pavilion with a curved slate cap among the vines

weingut.description: Winery: a manor house over vaulted cellars, with a press house beside it; front facing +x

wohnwagen.description: Caravan with an awning, 6 m long

campingbaracke.description: Campsite reception and wash house: a long low timber building; front facing +x

badehaus.description: Lido changing huts and kiosk by the lake: a row of little timber cabins under one roof; front facing +x

sonnenschirm.description: Parasol and a table at a beer garden or the lido

raddampfer.description: Paddle steamer of the Saxon fleet: a long white hull with paddle boxes, a saloon deck and a raked yellow funnel; bow facing +x

faehre.description: Elbe ferry: a flat pontoon boat with a little wheelhouse, ramps at both ends; ramps along ±x

anleger.description: Steamer landing stage: a floating pontoon with a little ticket hut and a gangway to the bank (gangway toward +x)

ruderboot.description: Rowing boat drawn up on the bank or moored, 4.5 m long

lokschuppen.description: Engine shed of the depot: brick, three roads under a sawtooth roof with smoke vents, tall doors facing +x

drehscheibe.description: Turntable: a round pit with a girder bridge across it, 20 m across

stellwerk.description: Signal box: a brick ground floor with a timbered, glazed operating room above and a hipped roof; front (windows) facing +x

bekohlung.description: Coaling stage of the depot: a raised bunker of coal on brick piers with a small crane

prellbock.description: Buffer stop at the end of a siding

personenaufzug.description: The Personenaufzug: a 50 m steel lift tower with a footbridge at the top to the cliff; footbridge toward +x

festung-kirche.description: The fortress's garrison church: a white nave and a west tower with a slate bell-cap

bahnhof-gross.description: Main-line station building: two storeys of sandstone, a hipped slate roof, a clock gable over the entrance; door at the back

bahnhof-klein.description: Small country station: a half-timbered upper floor over a sandstone ground floor, a steep roof with a little canopy; door at the back

wartehalle.description: Tram stop shelter: a little timber hut open toward the platform, a bench inside, a shingled roof

kohlebunker.description: Colliery loading bunker: a tall concrete hopper on legs over the siding, with a conveyor housing climbing to it; door at the back
